newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BORDER 165-2 AT LUNCH AGAINST NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BORDER 165-2 AT LUNCH AGAINST NATAL.

text.p: Border, chasing 385 to win, were well-placed on 165 for two in their second innings at lunch on the final day of their four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Natal at Kingsmead on Monday.
Natal 332 (Dale Benkenstein 129, Mark Bruyns 73, Shaun Pollock 66; Vasbert Drakes 8-59) and 257 (Shaun Pollock 77, Doug Watson 75).
Border 205 and 165 for two (Frans Cronje 67 not out).
